title: Cantautor
tagline: Songwriters who place words, melody, and personal perspective up front.
summary: Cantautor describes singer-songwriters, especially within Spanish- and Catalan-language traditions, who write and perform their own material. The music can draw on folk, pop, and regional forms, often using lyrics to address personal or social themes. It is a broad songwriting tradition rather than one fixed arrangement or sound.

pillars.name: Joan Manuel Serrat
pillars.why: Serrat is a major Catalan and Spanish-language songwriter whose repertoire combines poetry and popular song.

pillars.name: Silvio Rodríguez
pillars.why: Rodríguez became one of the most recognized voices of Nueva Trova through intimate, socially engaged songwriting.

pillars.name: Paco Ibáñez
pillars.why: Ibáñez is known for setting Spanish poetry to music and bringing literary texts into a singer-songwriter format.
